notice.expiredSession: Your session has expired. Request a new access link to continue.
notice.invalidLink: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.

request.intro: Enter the email address you send files from. If this address has already been verified on this service, you will receive a link by email to manage your transfers.
request.label: Your email address
request.hint: The link is valid for 15 minutes and can be used only once.
request.invalid: Enter a valid email address, for example name@example.com.
request.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please wait before trying again.
request.mailUnavailable: The email could not be sent. Please try again later.
request.sentText: If this address has already been verified on this service, you will receive a link valid for 15 minutes.
request.sentHint: Nothing arrived? Check your spam folder, or request a link again. The link works once, in the browser where you open it.

switch.title: Open this link?
switch.text: You are signed in as {email}. Open the link and switch?
switch.hint: Only open it if you requested this link yourself. Opening it ends your current session.

list.intro: Your transfers in progress, most recent first.
list.empty: You have no transfer in progress.
list.caption: Transfers in progress

detail.title: Transfer details

option.verification: Recipients verify their address by code

detail.trackingNone: No per-recipient tracking is available for this transfer.

extend.title: Extend the validity
extend.doneUntil: The transfer is now available until {date}.
extend.conflict: This transfer can no longer be extended. Reload the page.
extend.notAllowed: This duration is not allowed for this transfer.
extend.unavailable: This transfer cannot be extended: it has reached the maximum lifetime allowed or no longer offers a longer duration.
extend.unavailableState: This transfer cannot be extended in its current state.

delete.title: Delete the transfer
delete.text: Deleting the transfer makes its links unusable at once. The files are erased and this cannot be undone.
delete.confirm: Delete the transfer to {recipients}? The files will be erased and the links will stop working.
